verdict.rationale: The docs define a skill as a plain directory containing a `SKILL.md` file with `name`/`description` frontmatter, plus optional scripts and references. Skills build on the open agent skills standard, and skills can be checked into repos under `.agents/skills`. Portability is reinforced by a portable Agent Plugins manifest, a documented Claude Code plugin migration path, and community users editing skill .md files directly and moving them between Claude and Codex. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of a Codex skill actually running unchanged in a non-OpenAI harness.
